objectives.statement: Form event passives with bli plus past participle in present, simple past, and present perfect.
Recognize and place optional passive agents with av.
Use -s passive mainly in infinitive and present forms, especially after modal verbs.
Choose between bli-passive, -s passive, and active wording in natural Bokmål.

notes: Must teach both Norwegian passives: bli + past participle (blir/ble/har blitt) for events and processes, with optional agent introduced by av; and the s-passive (-s suffix, mainly infinitive/present and especially after modal verbs such as kan brukes, må gjøres). Contrast the two and warn against preterite/perfect s-passive forms. Avoid overusing passive where active Bokmål is more natural.
